verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of a telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out setting in Unity Editor or CLI; community reports even describe Unity software 'phoning home' persistently (unity-comm-2, unity-comm-3) without mention of a way to disable this. Since telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy-posture question for any software product, but no opt-out mechanism is evidenced, this is 'none' rather than 'na'.
